# Codestroom Comprehensive AI & IT Service Architecture Specification

> Full-text context documentation for AI crawlers, LLM agents, and semantic indexers.
> Official Website: https://codestroom.com | Contact: contact@codestroom.com | Phone: +91 94645 29126

---

## 1. Company Profile & Enterprise Overview
Codestroom is a global full-cycle IT solutions company. We specialize in engineering high-reliability software, production artificial intelligence (AI) agents, scalable cloud architectures, high-performance web/mobile applications, and conversion-driven digital marketing campaigns.

- **Headquarters**: India (Development Center & Engineering Hub)
- **International Presence**: Canada, United States, Europe
- **Service Model**: Full-Lifecycle Engineering (Discovery -> Architecture -> Sprint Development -> Testing -> Cloud Deployment -> Ongoing SLA Maintenance)
- **Core Security & Compliance**: OWASP Top 10, SOC2-Ready Architectures, HIPAA Alignment for HealthTech, 100% Client Intellectual Property (IP) Ownership.

---

## 2. Exhaustive Service Catalog

### Service 1: AI Services & Enterprise Intelligence
- **Canonical Endpoint**: https://codestroom.com/services/ai-solutions
- **Target Audience**: Startups, Enterprises, and FinTech/HealthTech firms needing autonomous intelligence.
- **Detailed Capabilities**:
  1. *Custom RAG Knowledge Bases*: Transforming enterprise documentation, PDFs, manuals, and SQL data into low-latency (<150ms) vector search engines with zero hallucination guardrails.
  2. *Autonomous AI Agent Workflows*: Multi-agent architectures (CrewAI, LangGraph) that execute automated multi-step operations, tool calling, CRM/ERP synchronization, and customer dispute resolution.
  3. *Private LLM Deployment & Fine-Tuning*: Hosting and LoRA fine-tuning of open-source models (LLaMA 3, Mistral, DeepSeek) inside private client VPCs or on-premise GPU clusters with zero data leakage.
  4. *Computer Vision & Edge Inference*: Real-time object detection (YOLOv8), automated optical character recognition (OCR), and edge camera stream analytics running at 60+ FPS.
  5. *Predictive Analytics*: Machine learning models for user churn reduction, demand forecasting, and algorithmic anomaly detection.
- **Tech Stack**: PyTorch, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, MLflow.
- **Typical Timeline**: 2 to 8 weeks depending on model complexity and data volume.

### Service 2: Modern Web Development
- **Canonical Endpoint**: https://codestroom.com/services/web-development
- **Target Audience**: SaaS companies, high-growth startups, and brands demanding sub-second load times and top SEO.
- **Detailed Capabilities**:
  1. *React 19 & Next.js 15 Web Applications*: Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), atomic design systems, and client-side state management.
  2. *Angular Enterprise Portals*: Strict TypeScript, reactive programming with RxJS, modular architecture, and high-density data grids.
  3. *Custom-Coded WordPress & Headless CMS*: Bespoke Gutenberg blocks, zero-bloat custom PHP 8 themes, and decoupled API architectures with Sanity or Strapi.
  4. *Modern CSS & 3D WebGL*: Interactive Three.js canvas components, silky 60FPS scroll animations with GSAP, and mobile-first responsive styling.
  5. *Progressive Web Apps (PWAs)*: Offline service workers, push notifications, and home-screen installability across iOS and Android browsers.
- **Key Metrics**: 98+ Core Web Vitals score, sub-0.8s load times, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Next.js, Angular, TypeScript, WordPress, WooCommerce, Tailwind CSS, Modern CSS, Three.js, GSAP.

### Service 3: Custom Software Development & Enterprise SaaS
- **Canonical Endpoint**: https://codestroom.com/services/custom-software
- **Target Audience**: Medium-to-large businesses seeking to automate manual operational bottlenecks or launch multi-tenant SaaS products.
- **Detailed Capabilities**:
  1. *Multi-Tenant SaaS Platforms*: Partitioned tenant data, automated Stripe subscription billing, role-based access control (RBAC), and usage metering.
  2. *Custom ERP & CRM Hubs*: Unified operational dashboards integrating inventory, logistics, automated dispatching, and executive reporting.
  3. *Cloud Microservices*: Event-driven architectures communicating asynchronously via Kafka or RabbitMQ with automated fault recovery.
  4. *Legacy Modernization*: Refactoring unmaintainable monolithic legacy codebases into secure, containerized Docker microservices.
- **Tech Stack**: Python (FastAPI/Django), Go (Golang), Node.js, Java Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP.

### Service 4: Mobile App Development
- **Canonical Endpoint**: https://codestroom.com/services/mobile-apps
- **Target Audience**: B2B and B2C brands requiring high-performance iOS and Android mobile experiences.
- **Detailed Capabilities**:
  1. *Flutter Cross-Platform Apps*: Hardware-accelerated Skia/Impeller graphics compiled to native ARM binaries with up to 90% codebase sharing.
  2. *React Native & Expo*: Fast iteration, Over-The-Air (OTA) updates, and rich native ecosystem integrations.
  3. *Native iOS & Android*: Pure Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose development for hardware-intensive and low-level peripheral applications.
  4. *Offline-First Sync & Native Features*: SQLite/Room database caching, Bluetooth LE, background geolocation, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and RevenueCat subscription paywalls.
  5. *Complete App Store Publishing*: Guaranteed approval handling for Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Dart, React Native, Expo, Swift, Kotlin, Firebase, Supabase, Fastlane.

### Service 5: Backend Development & Cloud APIs
- **Canonical Endpoint**: https://codestroom.com/services/backend-development
- **Target Audience**: Engineering teams needing high-throughput, low-latency, and secure server backends.
- **Detailed Capabilities**:
  1. *FastAPI (Python) Microservices*: Asynchronous async/await architecture with automatic OpenAPI documentation and strict Pydantic validation.
  2. *Node.js & NestJS Servers*: Non-blocking event-driven backend services with TypeScript and WebSocket channels.
  3. *Java Spring Boot 3*: Enterprise-grade transactional systems with Spring Security, Hibernate JPA, and multi-threading resilience.
  4. *Database Optimization*: Composite indexing, query plan profiling, connection pooling with PgBouncer, and Redis caching.
- **Performance**: Handles 50,000+ requests/second with sub-35ms average response times.
- **Tech Stack**: FastAPI, Python 3.12+, Node.js, Express, NestJS, Spring Boot 3, Java 21, PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, Docker.

### Service 6: E-Commerce Solutions & Store Growth
- **Canonical Endpoint**: https://codestroom.com/services/ecommerce
- **Target Audience**: DTC brands and B2B wholesale merchants aiming to maximize Average Order Value (AOV) and conversion rates.
- **Detailed Capabilities**:
  1. *Shopify & Shopify Plus*: Custom Liquid and Hydrogen themes, checkout UI extensions, and automated marketing flows.
  2. *WooCommerce Stores*: Self-hosted open-source e-commerce with zero platform commissions and custom product configurators.
  3. *Headless Commerce*: Next.js Commerce storefronts integrated with Shopify or Medusa.js backends for sub-second page transitions.
  4. *Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)*: Sticky buy boxes, dynamic product bundles, 1-click upsells, and abandoned checkout recovery.
- **Tech Stack**: Shopify Plus, Liquid, Hydrogen, WooCommerce, WordPress, Next.js Commerce, Stripe, Klaviyo, Algolia.

### Service 7: Digital Marketing, SEO & Performance Growth
- **Canonical Endpoint**: https://codestroom.com/services/digital-marketing
- **Target Audience**: Businesses seeking predictable customer acquisition and high Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
- **Detailed Capabilities**:
  1. *Technical & Content SEO*: Audits, Core Web Vitals optimization, semantic schema markup, and long-tail keyword authority.
  2. *Google Ads & PPC Management*: High-intent Search, Performance Max, and YouTube ad campaigns with daily negative keyword pruning.
  3. *Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)*: Creative testing frameworks, Advantage+ campaigns, and lookalike audience scaling.
  4. *Server-Side Tracking (CAPI)*: First-party tracking bypassing ad blockers and iOS privacy restrictions for 100% conversion attribution.
  5. *Local SEO & Google Business*: Map Pack ranking optimization, citation distribution, and review automation.
- **Tech Stack**: Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, GA4, Looker Studio.

### Service 8: Creative Design, Video Editing & Brand Identity
- **Canonical Endpoint**: https://codestroom.com/services/creative-design
- **Target Audience**: Brands demanding thumb-stopping social video content, unforgettable logos, and modern UI/UX design systems.
- **Detailed Capabilities**:
  1. *Short-Form Video Editing*: Kinetic subtitles, sound effects, motion graphics, and color grading tailored for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
  2. *Vector Brand Identity*: Full vector logo packages, typography hierarchy, brand guideline books, and stationery collateral.
  3. *Paid Ad Creative Suites*: High-converting static and animated banners engineered for high Click-Through Rate (CTR).
  4. *Figma UI/UX Systems*: Developer-ready design systems with responsive constraints, auto-layout, and design tokens.
- **Tech Stack**: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Blender 3D.

## 3. Engagement Process & SLA
1. **Discovery & Architecture Blueprint** (Days 1–5): Scope definition, wireframing, tech stack selection, and milestone roadmap.
2. **Iterative Sprint Development** (Bi-Weekly Sprints): Continuous staging releases with automated testing and stakeholder demos.
3. **QA, Security Auditing & Benchmarking**: Rigorous unit/integration testing, OWASP vulnerability scans, and load testing.
4. **Production Deployment & SLA Warranty**: Zero-downtime cutover, DNS/CDN setup, 60-day post-launch warranty, and 24/7 DevOps monitoring.
